title: Love is Blind
tagline: Dating is getting harder and harder... but what if an agent with your personality could "date" other peoples agent and really match with your other half?
description:
This project explores that age-old question by leveraging AI to help users discover meaningful connections beyond the surface. Here’s how it works: Users create digital agents—AI-driven copies of themselves that mirror their personalities, values, and communication styles. These agents autonomously interact with others, engaging in conversations, debates, and even playful banter to assess compatibility. Over time, they identify which agent pairs (and by extension, which real-life users) share the deepest alignment in interests, values, and emotional resonance.

By removing biases like appearance or social status, the experiment asks: Can love thrive when it’s rooted purely in personality? And what might AI teach us about human connection along the way?
